title: Production Learning & Cross-Service Trial Review VI
source_method: Read-only Supabase Production information_schema verification and one aggregate SELECT over 17 explicitly named public source tables; source rows and identities not retrieved

six_service_trial.source: Original Jobs/Production with Item 424 field observations
Original Jobs/change orders/Safety with Item 425 phases
Original Jobs/Dispatch/Storm/Workability with Item 427 removal events
Original Jobs/Dispatch/Storm/Workability with Item 427 plowing events
Original Jobs/Dispatch/Fleet/Safety with Item 428 disposal receipts

comparison.reason: No sampled first jobs and no active company-scoped source rows in the inspected Production tables

comparability_guards: The source must confirm original company, customer, property and company-scoped work-order identity and service entitlement for every row
Read permissions, complete six-service coverage, no pagination/query cap, and successful fresh reads are required in both periods
Nonoverlapping chronological periods and distinct first jobs/customers per service, at least ten each, are required
Missing stages or denominators below ten withhold that particular rate; stage-specific measurements remain descriptive only
Different service-specific observations and source receipts are not interchangeable financial, compliance, safety or operational outcomes
Zero in these seventeen inspected sources is not proof that every system or business is inactive

new_bounded_queue.title: Six-Service Owner Trial Intake & Source-Coverage Runbook
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: A guided company/entitlement and canonical first-customer/site/job checklist with a replay-safe review of missing evidence.
new_bounded_queue.source: Company registry, original CRM and Jobs and Item 429 gap snapshot
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No synthetic clients, entitlements or source writes.

new_bounded_queue.title: Service-Specific Intake Templates & Verified Site Constraints
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Per-service operator forms review necessary original site measurements and Safety prerequisites without duplicating CRM identities.
new_bounded_queue.source: Original customer/property/site data and permitted service templates
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No unverified conditions or automatic Safety approval.

new_bounded_queue.title: Cross-Service Estimate-to-Authorized-Job Handoff Audit
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Inspect original estimates, scope/price lineage, owner-approved handoff and company service identity with documented holds.
new_bounded_queue.source: Existing Estimate, Jobs and entitlement audit
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No autonomous estimate acceptance or customer commitment.

new_bounded_queue.title: Mobile Field Evidence Capture & Offline Replay Acceptance
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Verify phone retry identities, photo/doc capture receipts, offline recovery and no duplicate first-job evidence across six services.
new_bounded_queue.source: Existing mobile/offline outbox, Jobs and specialist receipts
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No offline authority escalation or fabricated upload success.

new_bounded_queue.title: Service Dispatch, Crew, Workability & Safety Preflight Review
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Show original dispatch/crew and site/weather/safety constraints per service with concrete missing-prerequisite actions.
new_bounded_queue.source: Dispatch, Staff, Workability, Fleet and Safety
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No automatic dispatch, site opening or lockout override.

new_bounded_queue.title: Shared Crew, Fleet, Equipment & Materials Conflict Review
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Expose dated shared capacity and double-allocation conflicts without summing duplicate resource costs.
new_bounded_queue.source: Assignment schedules, Fleet, Equipment and material-issue ledger
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No automatic crew reassignment or stock adjustment.

new_bounded_queue.title: Service-Native Production & Evidence Completion Review
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Compare each service's factual field record and original photo/ticket provenance without substituting one service's safety or quality measures for another's.
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No regulatory certification, automatic job completion or invented measured quantities.

new_bounded_queue.title: Quality-Control, Exception & Customer Handoff Acceptance
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Trace supervisor/QC decisions and customer sign-off gaps for each completed original job.
new_bounded_queue.source: Existing Quality Control and canonical Jobs closeout
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No silent sign-off, public sharing or automatic messaging.

new_bounded_queue.title: Six-Service Job-Cost Provenance & Price Variance Review
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Reconcile source-authoritative labour, asset, material and estimate amounts by service where eligible and label missing/capped sources.
new_bounded_queue.source: Original Timekeeping, Fleet/Equipment, Materials, Estimates and Finance
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No double-booking costs, employee ranking or projected ROI presented as fact.

new_bounded_queue.title: Owner-Gated Invoice Candidate & Receivable Trace
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Inspect invoicing readiness and AR lineage from original approved closeouts with manual review gates.
new_bounded_queue.source: Jobs closeout, Finance invoice and AR sources
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No autonomous invoice, collection or customer charging.

new_bounded_queue.title: Seasonal Contracts, Plowing Events & Recurring First-Use Continuity
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Tie original season agreements and storm-event visit instances to the same customer/site without billing or event duplication.
new_bounded_queue.source: Recurring, Dispatch, Storm and service entitlement sources
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No invented storms, service auto-renewal or auto-dispatch.

new_bounded_queue.title: Live Field Trial Integrity, Privacy & Release-Readiness Audit
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Audit pilot sample authorization, tenant boundaries, stale/capped source coverage and exact deployment/CI status before owner sign-off.
new_bounded_queue.source: Canonical source receipts, auth/RLS and release workflows
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No approval or trial outcome without original evidence.

new_bounded_queue.title: Production Learning & Cross-Service Trial Review VII
new_bounded_queue.acceptance: Recheck two real nonoverlapping same-service cohorts, publish only adequately supported descriptive outcomes and reprioritize a bounded roadmap.
new_bounded_queue.source: Dated authorized canonical service-specific first-job cohorts
new_bounded_queue.boundary: No inferred improvement, ROI, staff ranking or autonomous business transaction.

no_mutations: No schema, RLS, permissions, company entitlements, customer, Jobs, Safety, Dispatch, Finance, Equipment or live field evidence were changed by the Build 429 review.
